'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Gaza war]]
**[[January 2025 Gaza war ceasefire|2025 Gaza war ceasefire]], [[Gaza war hostage crisis]]
***[[Israel]] says that forensic testing revealed one of the bodies returned by [[Hamas]] yesterday does not match with [[Kidnapping of the Bibas family|Shiri Bibas]] nor with any other hostages. Her sons Ariel and Kfir, as well as [[Oded Lifshitz]], were all positively identified. Israel accuses Hamas of violating the ceasefire and demands the return of her body along with the other remaining hostages. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cjry3jzedl1o (BBC News)]
***Hamas claims that Shiri's body was "mistakenly mixed" with others who were killed and buried under the rubble in [[Gaza Strip|Gaza]], and returns an additional body the group says is hers. The identity is soon afterwards positively confirmed by Israel. [https://english.alarabiya.net/News/middle-east/2025/02/21/hamas-says-shiri-bibas-remains-mixed-with-other-human-remains-after-israeli-airstrike (Al Arabiya)] [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cjw20d3l4jpo (BBC News)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[2025 United States federal mass layoffs]]
**The [[United States]] [[Department of Defense (United States)|Department of Defense]] announces it will jointly [[layoff|lay off]] 4,500 [[probation (workplace)|probationary workers]], cutting 5-8% of the [[United States federal civil service|civilian workforce]]. The [[United States Forest Service]] also announces it will lay off 2,000 employees. [https://apnews.com/article/pentagon-job-cuts-trump-doge-31e3ed62f5f35a5e5a4a07fd8708232f (AP)]
*The [[Financial Action Task Force]] removes the [[Philippines]] from its [[FATF grey list|grey list]] and adds [[Laos]] and [[Nepal]] to the list. [https://www.reuters.com/world/fatf-global-financial-crime-watchdog-removes-philippines-grey-list-2025-02-21/ (Reuters)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[Real Plaza Trujillo collapse]]
**At least 6 people are killed and 79 others are injured after a roof collapses at the [[Real Plaza Trujillo]] [[shopping mall]] in [[Trujillo, Peru|Trujillo]], [[Peru]]. [https://metro.co.uk/2025/02/22/shopping-centre-roof-collapses-killing-least-3-including-child-injuring-79-22606215/ (''Metro'')]

*Twelve people are killed and twenty-one others were injured in a bus crash in [[São Paulo (state)|São Paulo]], [[Brazil]]. [https://www.trtworld.com/latin-america/twelve-university-students-killed-in-brazil-bus-crash-officials-18267535/ (TRT World)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[South Sudan]] orders the closure of all schools in the country for two weeks due to a [[heat wave]], with temperatures expected to reach {{conv|42|C|F}}. [https://www.dw.com/en/heat-wave-forces-south-sudan-to-close-schools-for-two-weeks/a-71698826 (DW)]
*A [[norovirus]] outbreak with a large number of ill passengers is reported on the [[MS Iona]] cruise ship in [[Belgium]]. [https://metro.co.uk/2025/02/21/cruise-passengers-dropping-like-flies-norovirus-outbreak-22605507/ (''Metro'')]

'''International relations'''
*[[January 2025 Gaza war ceasefire|2025 Gaza war ceasefire]]
**[[Egypt]], [[Jordan]], and the countries of the [[Gulf Cooperation Council]] meet in [[Riyadh]], [[Saudi Arabia]], to address possible future developments in the [[Gaza Strip]]. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/arab-leaders-gather-in-saudi-arabia-to-hash-out-alternative-to-trumps-plan-for-gaza/ (''The Times of Israel'')] 
*[[Kyrgyzstan–Tajikistan relations]]
**[[Kyrgyzstan]] and [[Tajikistan]] sign an agreement to [[national boundary delimitation|delimitate]] [[Kyrgyzstan–Tajikistan border|their border]], solving a decades-old [[territorial disputes|border dispute]] that had sparked clashes between different ethnic groups that had killed over a hundred people. [https://en.trend.az/casia/kyrgyzstan/4008880.html (Trend News Agency)] [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/kyrgyzstan-tajikistan-settle-border-dispute-that-sparked-deadly-clashes-2025-02-21/ (Reuters)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2024 South Korean martial law crisis]]
**[[Arrest of Yoon Suk Yeol]]
***[[Police of South Korea|South Korean police]] file a case against [[impeachment of Yoon Suk Yeol|impeached]] [[President of South Korea|president]] [[Yoon Suk Yeol]] for obstructing [[Arrest of Yoon Suk Yeol|his arrest warrant]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/south-korea-police-say-building-case-against-yoon-obstructing-arrest-2025-02-21/ (Reuters)]
*[[Berlin Holocaust memorial stabbing]]
**A 30-year-old [[Spain|Spanish]] tourist is seriously injured in a [[Berlin Holocaust memorial stabbing|stabbing attack]] at the [[Memorial to the Murdered Jews of Europe]] in [[Berlin]], [[Germany]]. A 19-year-old Syrian man is arrested. [https://apnews.com/article/germany-berlin-stabbing-holocaust-memorial-1710be90a0e733d016e32db4d8353e1c (AP)] [https://www.dw.com/en/suspect-in-berlin-stabbing-wanted-to-kill-jews-police/a-71712971 (DW)]
*[[Flint water crisis]]
**[[Veolia Water]] agrees to pay $53 million in [[settlement (litigation)|settlement]] for all remaining active [[class action]] [[lawsuit]]s for the [[water pollution|contamination]] of [[drinking water]] in [[Flint, Michigan|Flint]], [[Michigan]], United States, but refuses to acknowledge any fault in the crisis. [https://apnews.com/article/flint-water-settlement-lead-3cadd9eb6ffbd699159c992de9cdbc27 (AP)] [https://www.wnem.com/2025/02/21/53m-civil-settlement-reached-flint-water-crisis-lawsuit/ (WNEM)]
*[[Stabbing of Salman Rushdie#Criminal investigation and prosecution|Stabbing of Salman Rushdie]]
**Hadi Matar is found guilty by a [[Juries in the United States|U.S. jury]] of [[attempted murder]] and [[assault]] for his [[stabbing attack]] on author [[Salman Rushdie]] in 2022. [https://abcnews.go.com/US/salman-rushdie-stabbing-suspect-found-guilty-attempted-murder/story?id=118903519 (ABC News)]
*Three people are killed in a shooting outside of a [[Department of motor vehicles|motor vehicle office]] in [[Louisville, Kentucky]], United States. [https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/crime/louisville-shooting-three-dead-willismore-b2702549.html (''The Independent'')]
*Three people, including two [[Virginia Beach Police Department|police officers]], are killed during a traffic stop in [[Virginia Beach, Virginia|Virginia Beach]], [[Virginia]], United States. [https://www.nytimes.com/2025/02/22/us/virginia-beach-police-shooting.html?searchResultPosition=1 (''The New York Times'')]
*The [[Supreme Federal Court]] of [[Brazil]] orders the suspension of [[online video platform]] [[Rumble (company)|Rumble]] for [[contempt of court|refusing to comply]] to court orders and for refusing to remove the account of Brazilian [[fugitive]] [[Allan dos Santos]]. [https://apnews.com/article/brazil-supreme-court-rumble-blocked-c45ab801d5bb23e6d9b2271bdcf7426e (AP)]
